roleContext.roleTitle: Night Shift Manager, Parcel Sortation Hub
roleContext.jobDescription: A parcel carrier's regional hub sorts around 180,000 parcels a night for next-day delivery. The Night Shift Manager runs the night shift of agency and permanent staff, plans the sort so trunk vehicles leave on time, leads health and safety on the sort floor and reports each shift's results to the hub general manager. The role works a four-on, four-off pattern of 12-hour night shifts. A hiring panel reviews the factual evidence for each applicant and makes its own decisions. The night shift numbers about 85 people. The manager reports to the hub general manager and works with the site's health and safety adviser and the transport planners who set the trunk schedule.

requirements.text: Manages a night shift of 60 or more permanent and agency staff in a parcel or warehouse operation.
Plans the sort so that trunk vehicles depart on time, and redesigns sort-zone layouts when volumes change.
Works a four-on, four-off pattern of 12-hour night shifts.
Leads health and safety on the floor and holds a recognised health and safety qualification.
Reports shift performance to the site general manager.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Night Shift Manager, Parcel Sortation Hub

## Experience

- Managed the night shift at the Daventry sortation centre of Swiftway Parcels: about 75 staff, a third of them supplied by two agencies, across inbound, sort and outbound.
- Planned labour by sort zone against the forecast volume and the trunk departure schedule, holding a 02:30 checkpoint to move staff to zones running behind.
- Investigated floor accidents and near misses on the shift, completing the RIDDOR-reportable incident forms with the site safety adviser where required.
- Sent the end-of-shift report to the hub general manager: volume sorted, trunk departures against schedule, missorts and staffing.
- Introduced a standard checklist for the shift's opening safety walk, used by every team leader.

## Work samples

- Work sample: an anonymised end-of-shift report for one night, with volume sorted, each trunk vehicle's planned and actual departure time, the missort count and staffing against plan.
